negative_evidence: The model is fitted/normative; human trajectories do not directly measure the proposed forward/inverse neural states.
Generalization from established adaptation coevolution to de-novo skill learning requires care.
Motor synergies are an internal representation/factorization choice and must not be confused with the externally imposed target-capture task.
Exact exponential convergence is conditional: no inverse exploration noise, persistently exciting perceptual/motion input, sufficiently small gamma^2/(eta k_P), and initialization in Omega_c.
With stochastic exploration noise, trajectories remain in an O(|sigma_u|) neighborhood rather than converge exactly to zero.
unresolved_issues: Neural implementation is not directly measured.
Exact convergence is conditional; stochastic exploration has bounded-neighborhood rather than zero convergence.

annotation: direct model ancestors include 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1007118 and 10.1207/s15516709cog1603_1; global genealogy independence not certified

preserved_noninferences: external history or trajectory cannot automatically become memory state
fitted latent/parameter cannot automatically become stored memory
prediction error cannot automatically become persistent coordinator state
learned parameter cannot automatically become active controller beyond its source-defined role
motor target cannot automatically become internal skill state
complexity or fit failure cannot imply A2
no genealogy path/citation is not independence
